beats.en: At home Chinna put his shoes in the corner, dropped his bag, and rested his head on the table. His mother Kamala saw this, came to him and asked gently what had happened.

textbookBox.concept: At the pineapple stall the fruit seller said each pineapple cost forty-five rupees. Kamala bought two and gave a hundred-rupee note. She asked Chinna to take the change while she went to other shops.

beats.en: At the pineapple stall the fruit seller said each pineapple cost forty-five rupees. Kamala bought two and gave a hundred-rupee note. She asked Chinna to take the change while she went to other shops.
beats.speakEn: At the pineapple stall the fruit seller said each pineapple cost forty-five rupees. Kamala bought two and gave a hundred-rupee note. She asked Chinna to take the change while she went to other shops.

beats.en: Chinna thought about it and ran back to return the extra money. The fruit seller was very happy and called Chinna an honest boy. Kamala was pleased and took Chinna to Chacha's shop, just as Chacha was about to close.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 english · The Tinkling Bells · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Calm, honest, loyal, kind, fair, truth, respect, courage, love and peace are words for good qualities and values. Honest means telling the truth and not taking what is not yours.
